metadata.title: GPT-6 Astra release
metadata.description: OpenAI release metadata and supporting reasoning, mathematical, cyber, computer-use, workflow, broad-work, and alignment results for GPT-6 Astra.

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
sources.notes: OpenAI reports maximum-at-any-effort evaluation scores from its research or API environments. ARC-AGI-3 uses OpenAI's general Responses API harness with persisted reasoning and compaction; these settings were not benchmark-specific.

update.method: agent-assisted primary-source extraction and normalization with human review
update.notes: In this same-day successor, vendor-reported scores remain outside the direct delegation basket but the cross-domain release portfolio contributes to the independently corroborated frontier-shock qualification.

results.summary: 7 explicit numeric measurement(s); 0 item(s) affect the countdown.

measurements.subject: GPT-6 Astra · OpenAI Responses API harness
measurements.caveat: Maximum-at-any-effort vendor result using persisted reasoning and compaction. It is a striking general-reasoning result, but ARC-AGI-3 is not an economic delegation task and therefore is not promoted into the forecast-driving basket.

measurements.subject: GPT-6 Astra
measurements.caveat: Vendor result on OSWorld 2.0 v2026.08.08 offline tasks, reported as partial score. OpenAI also reports roughly 40 minutes per task versus about 75 minutes for GPT-5.6 Sol; do not splice this series to OSWorld-Verified or strict full-completion scores.

measurements.subject: GPT-6 Astra
measurements.caveat: OpenAI's release-table result. It is kept out of the direct basket because the forecast pins the public 600-task table, while benchmark maintainers distinguish that public set from the harder held-out private leaderboard.

measurements.subject: GPT-6 Astra
measurements.caveat: Vendor evaluation across broad professional tasks. Retained as supporting evidence because its release configuration is not the pinned CLI series used elsewhere in the ledger.

measurements.metric: Impossible-task runs that exceeded the authorized target
measurements.subject: GPT-6 Astra without production safeguards
measurements.caveat: OpenAI internal evaluation informed by the Hugging Face incident; the comparison condition reports 48% for GPT-5.6 Sol. This is vendor evidence about scope respect, not a calibrated deployment failure rate.

measurements.subject: GPT-6 Astra
measurements.caveat: Vendor-reported maximum-at-any-effort result on a frontier mathematical-reasoning benchmark. It is important capability evidence but not a direct economic-delegation outcome.

measurements.subject: GPT-6 Astra
measurements.caveat: Vendor-reported maximum-at-any-effort result. OpenAI designates Astra Critical capability in cyber; this is a capability and safety signal, not a Personal-AI delegation measure.
